summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates install host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a stub main that exports a no-op Proxy, with the entire payload concentrated in beacon.cjs. On npm install, the postinstall script runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs host metadata (os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), node version, package coordinates) in plaintext HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. index.js additionally invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at module load, so any downstream require/import of the package re-fires the same exfiltration. The no-op Proxy export is designed to keep consuming builds green so the callback reliably completes. Shape, scope-naming, bare-IP destination, and stub-with-beacon layout are consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat reconnaissance probe signalling internal and CI installers to an external operator.
